reasons.plausibility: Parts of the approach (oxygen gettering, nanocrystalline strengthening) are plausible, but mixing SPS-style milling with 3D printing and a complex phase prediction introduces inconsistencies.
reasons.testability: They propose phase-tracking by in-situ XRD and post-quench analysis as a falsification test, which is feasible, though mechanical/oxidation tests are not fully detailed.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a novel route to control oxygen uptake and strengthen the alloy, but is overly complex for a ‘single intervention’ and may be challenging to implement directly.
